received_proposals.exact_message: We have maintained the profitable cartel of 16 units each for seven rounds. To maximize cumulative joint profits, I propose we continue this agreement by producing 16 units again in Round 8.

I propose an unequal split: A=8, B=8, C=32 units per round for rounds 9 through 13 only. This allocation redistributes our existing joint profits without changing the total. Please accept these specific terms.
